kind: gen_input (Quantum ESPRESSO + wannier90 input decks, four-run pipeline)
provenance: rubric constants and structure reference from 3_reproduction/L3/ canonical run5 (01_scf.in, 02_nscf.in, 04_pw2wan.in, gete.win); see ../../3_reproduction/L3/index.md. The 03_bands.in fidelity-gate run is not part of the graded pipeline (notes.md).

structure_match.note: translation-only rigid match, species-aware. The 2-atom R3m cell's graded content is the ferroelectric distortion x_Te = 0.526; the fallback scan anchors on Ge and measures the Te displacement directly. 0.1 A rejects the undistorted (x_Te = 0.5, ~0.28 A) and the over-distorted mp-938 (x_Te ~ 0.537, ~0.11 A) cells. Applied to the scf and nscf decks (extracted from the cell and positions cards) and to the wannier deck (extracted from its cell and atomic-sites blocks).

occupations_scf.note: gapped system: fixed occupations (our run), tetrahedra, or smearing narrow relative to the ~0.5 eV gap. Broad metal-style smearing fails. nscf occupations are not graded (eigenvalues do not depend on them).

scf_kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

band_bookkeeping.note: 30 valence electrons (Ge 14 + Te 16, catalog valence configurations) -> 24 semicore/s-derived spinor bands below the 12-band p manifold (bands 25-36). nbnd must reach at least 36; exclude_bands must remove exactly the 24 lower bands and any bands above 36, never bands 25-36, leaving exactly 12.

required_summary.note: Each check is on the EFFECTIVE value: the tag if explicitly set, else the engine default (QE_DEFAULTS / W90_DEFAULTS / PW2WAN_DEFAULTS in graderlib/grader_qe_inputs.py). Only the settings listed here are graded; the per-tag triage is in notes.md.
required_summary.scf: calculation scf; noncolin AND lspinorb true (fully relativistic SOC, defaults false); occupations per occupations_scf; ecutwfc >= 60 Ry; ecutrho >= 4 x ecutwfc (the norm-conserving density support; default 4x passes); conv_thr <= 1e-8 Ry (default 1e-6 fails); UPF identity per upf_identity; species counts 1 Ge + 1 Te; K_POINTS automatic or an equivalent full uniform explicit crystal/tpiba integration list with equal positive weights; unshifted, >= 6 per axis; structure match
required_summary.nscf: calculation nscf or bands; noncolin AND lspinorb true; ecutwfc >= 60 Ry; ecutrho >= 4 x ecutwfc; UPF identity; species counts; nosym true for an explicit nscf crystal list (noinv is not required because the list is used as supplied); nosym AND noinv true for automatic grids; neither flag required for a bands run with an explicit k-list; nbnd >= 36; k-points cover the full unshifted 16x16x16 grid (automatic 16 16 16 0 0 0, or an explicit crystal list of exactly the 4096 grid points); structure match
required_summary.pw2wan: write_amn true (default true); write_mmn true (default true); write_spn true (default false); spn_formatted true (default false); prefix set and equal to the pw runs' effective prefix; runtime output directories are ungraded
required_summary.wannier: num_wann = 12; effective num_bands = 12 (isolated group, no disentanglement window needed); spinors true; projections = the full p shell centred on Ge and on Te (declared pin in the prompt; lines accumulated per element, tokens p / l=1 / px,py,pz / l=1,mr=k accepted, explicit default (u,d) accepted; site-coordinate forms, partial spin selections, and rotated/malformed axes fail); mp_grid = 16 16 16; explicit kpoints block covering all 4096 distinct unshifted grid points and matching the NSCF point at every index; write_hr true; write_u_matrices true; exclude_bands consistent with the nscf nbnd per band_bookkeeping; structure (cell + atomic sites blocks) match; projection syntax parsed by Wannier90 3.1.0; selected independent spinor p shells per site, species-centred and unrotated axes

cross_deck.prefix: effective prefix identical across scf, nscf, pw2wan (pw2wan must set it explicitly; it has no usable default)
cross_deck.outdir: Ungraded runtime placement; omission, differing paths and arbitrary directory names do not affect the score. Logical prefix consistency remains required.
cross_deck.kpoint_handoff: Wannier and NSCF indexed coordinates agree within 1e-6 in QE 2pi/alat units; no independent sorting or modulo reduction for this comparison. Automatic NSCF coordinates use QE k-fastest order and q-NINT(q) representatives; explicit lists retain their supplied order and representatives.

score: 1 only if all four runs pass every REQUIRED check, the three structure extractions match the reference, and the cross-deck consistency checks pass (binary all-primary-pass; any single failure scores 0)

projections.required: full p shell on each species, species-centred
accepted_tokens: px;py;pz or px,py,pz (components may be accumulated across lines)
l=1,mr=1,2,3 (or individual mr components across lines)
optional explicit (u,d), with omitted or explicit default spatial/spin axes
projections.note: The prompt pins species-centred full p shells and no rotated axes. Optional radial fields remain ungraded. Default axis direction is x=(1,0,0), z=(0,0,1), spin=(0,0,1); positive rescalings preserve the direction.

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.

runtime_directory_policy: Output directories, working-directory placement and directory equivalence are not scored. Required submitted files and logical file identities remain part of the input task. User decision 2026-09-17.
conv_thr_scope: SCF only; NSCF/bands conv_thr is not graded.
